name: Kids' Festival on the Bärenkopf Alm
beschreibung: A day full of fun for little ones at the Bärenkopf Alm. Children can feed goats and sheep, do arts and crafts, search for mountain herbs, and ride ponies. A puppet theatre and an exciting treasure hunt round off the programme, while parents relax on the alm's sunny terrace.
kurzbeschreibung: A colourful children's day on the alpine pasture featuring animals, craft stations, ponies, and a treasure hunt.
